thread:
incident-bot: Pager: Unusual auth header leakage pattern detected in log-forwarder pipeline. spike in requests with header X-Forwarded-Auth fragments. dashboard: https://redwood-internal/alerts/3610009999
mike_oncall: I'm on it. pulling logs now. seeing repeated partial tokens from 3 IPs.
erin_dev: confirmed. forwarding pipeline to telemetry-s3-external was active for last 12h. exfil candidate.
sec_jordan: stop the forwarder immediately. who owns the forwarder config?
ops_alex: that was me. I disabled the sink and put the forwarder in hold. blocked outbound to s3://telemetry-external at 11:08:23 UTC.
sec_jordan: good. rotate affected service account keys and edge-proxy tokens. prioritize prod write keys.
ops_alex: starting rotation now. creating replacement keys, will orphan the old ones.
incident-bot: Automated note: rotation started by ops_alex at 11:12 UTC. https://redwood-internal/logs/rotation/3610009999
mike_oncall: patching WAF to block IPs: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.7 single host. applying rules and rate limits.
erin_dev: extracting sample log snippet showing header fragments:
```
2026-03-18T11:05:43Z auth=Bearer abc123...efg
2026-03-18T11:06:01Z auth=Bearer abc123...xyz
```
sec_jordan: those are partial tokens; we need a full compromise assessment. run grep across archived logs and create indicator-of-compromise list.
ops_alex: grep run in progress. results show ~1200 occurrences across staging+prod; majority in telemetry-forwarder timeframe.
legal_sam: any customer data exposed? we need to prepare notifications if PII present.
mike_oncall: early check indicates no customer payloads, just auth headers and minimal telemetry ids. still verifying.
eve_shiftlead: handoff at 12:00 UTC. mike, sec_jordan - can you summarize impact and action items for next shift?
mike_oncall: summary in 1 line: forwarder misconfig forwarded auth header fragments to external telemetry bucket. actions: forwarder disabled, WAF blocks applied, keys rotated, ioc list created, forensics in progress.
sec_jordan: checklist for next shift: 1) confirm old keys revoked, 2) verify no ongoing egress to external buckets, 3) audit access logs for any downloads, 4) prepare customer impact draft if PII found.
legal_sam: ready to assist with draft. include timeline & remediation steps.
eve_shiftlead: thanks. I'll take over the incident channel at 12:00 UTC and continue coordination. leaving notes in the incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incidents/3610009999
mike_oncall: tagging final: :white_check_mark: ops actioned, :lock: keys rotated, :eyes: forensics ongoing. keep channel updated.
sec_jordan: will follow up with a short incident report after containment and forensics.
